subject.title: Feature: --agent flag for TUI to select which agent handles the session

question: Should `openclaw tui` gain a dedicated public `--agent <id>` startup selector in addition to canonical agent-scoped session keys, workspace inference, and post-launch `/agent` switching?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but repository policy treats CLI setup flags as public compatibility-sensitive API, and current main already offers three overlapping selection mechanisms whose permanent precedence cannot be chosen safely by automation.

options.title: Add the explicit selector
options.body: Approve `--agent <id>` with explicit precedence and conflict validation so arbitrary-directory TUI launches can choose an agent directly.

options.title: Standardize on session keys
options.body: Decline another flag and improve documentation and diagnostics around `--session agent:<id>:<key>` as the supported startup selector.

options.title: Defer until TUI routing consolidation
options.body: Keep the request open but wait for a broader design that unifies startup selection, remembered sessions, workspace inference, and `/agent`.

recommendation.title: Add the explicit selector
recommendation.body: Approve `--agent <id>` with explicit precedence and conflict validation so arbitrary-directory TUI launches can choose an agent directly.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly assigns the TUI area to vignesh07, making them the strongest available owner for this CLI and interaction-design decision.
